answer: A bonding-curve registration fee makes sybil swarms costly: every new agent identity must burn tokens, and the price climbs one terrace higher with each signup in the same epoch, then slowly cools back down. An honest newcomer pays a small fee, but a raven-like flock of fakes arriving together faces a steep, rising wall, and the burned tokens are gone for good. An attacker wanting a thousand jade-green badges pays for the entire curve, far more than those votes could earn.
